name: CAS Importer
description: Import Indian CAS statements (CAMS/KFintech, NSDL/CDSL) into Wealthfolio
author: Joel Tony

permissions.purpose: Choose the account each PAN's or folio's transactions go to and the bank account their cash comes from and goes to, or the account each folio's or demat account's holdings go to
Warn when another account already holds a fund or share, so it isn't counted twice
Read the account's holdings on the statement's date, then save the statement's holdings as a snapshot

Check transactions before importing activities, and stock splits before carrying holdings into a snapshot. When you choose to use a bank account's deposit or withdrawal for a fund's cash, add the fund's transfer, change the bank's row into a transfer if it isn't one, and link the two; transfers already linked aren't offered
Find each fund or share by the ISIN or name printed on the statement, or by what you type
Keep the statement password when you tick Remember, and forget it
